sql:
WITH tagged AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, amount,
         CASE WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%wohnungsgenossenschaft%'
                   OR lower(title) LIKE '%elternbeitrag%'
                   OR category IN ('Housing', 'Insurance', 'Subscriptions', 'Communication')
              THEN 'Fixkosten' ELSE 'Uebrige Ausgaben' END AS topic
  FROM transaction_view

),
per_month AS (
  SELECT month, topic, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM tagged

)

FROM per_month
ORDER BY topic, month
